rite.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.1.desc: Defeat 20 enemies while standing on lava.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.2.desc: Offer 64 ingots of at least 3 types.
rite.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss summoned with the altar within 4 blocks of lava.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.2.desc: Offer 16 cooked meats of at least 3 types.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss and offer one of its drops on the altar.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.2.desc: Offer 4 obsidian, 16 iron ingots and 1 anvil.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss after taking at least 10 of its hits without dying.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.3.o0: Boss defeated after 10 of its hits
rite.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.1.desc: Defeat 40 enemies with an ally (player or pet) within 12 blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.2.desc: Build a camp next to the altar (6 blocks): 1 campfire, 4 banners and 2 beds.
rite.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss with at least 2 allies (players or pets) within 12 blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.2.desc: With the altar underwater, offer 16 prismarine crystals, 8 sea lanterns and 3 nautilus shells.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.3.desc: Defeat an elder guardian, or a rite boss summoned with the altar underwater.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.2.desc: Offer 32 fish of 4 types and an enchanted fishing rod.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.3.desc: Offer a treasure item you fished up and defeat a rite boss.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.1.desc: Defeat 30 enemies that are in water.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.2.desc: Offer 4 sponges, 8 coral blocks and 3 water buckets.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss using Wave or Water Wall at least 3 times.
rite.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.3.o0: Boss defeated with 3 waves or walls
rite.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.1.desc: Take 50 projectile hits and defeat 20 enemies (skeletons don't count).
rite.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.2.desc: Offer 64 bones, 32 arrows and 4 bone blocks.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss after taking at least 10 projectiles from it or its escort without dying.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.specter.1.desc: Defeat 20 flying mobs (phantoms, vexes, blazes, ghasts…).
rite.rpgclasses.undead.specter.2.desc: Offer 16 phantom membranes, 16 feathers and 4 ender pearls.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.specter.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss using Ethereal Form at least 3 times during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.1.desc: Defeat 30 hostile mobs at night or in light level 7 or less.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.2.desc: Offer 16 redstone dust, 8 beetroots and 8 red mushrooms.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.3.desc: Defeat a rite boss recovering at least 100 HP with Thirst during the fight.
rite.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.3.o0: Boss defeated healing 100 HP with Thirst
subclass.rpgclasses.agile_scout.desc: Swift scout: more speed, triple jump and wall climbing.
subclass.rpgclasses.agile_scout.name: Agile Scout
subclass.rpgclasses.arcane_blade.desc: A Rogue who also casts spells: loses the Magic wall, gains mana and power, and their first spell from invisibility hits harder.
subclass.rpgclasses.arcane_blade.name: Arcane Blade
subclass.rpgclasses.battle_mage.desc: A front-line Mage who alternates sword and spell. Each spell imbues your weapon with its school (fire burns, ice slows, lightning jumps, blood heals, nature poisons, ender takes you behind the target, evocation raises fangs, eldritch releases a sonic wave in a line and water pushes); every 3 consecutive hits your next spell costs less mana. You aren't interrupted when casting, you lose the melee weapon walls and the mana you spend gives you a shield.
subclass.rpgclasses.battle_mage.name: Battle Mage
subclass.rpgclasses.beast_master.desc: Your bonded pets are stronger, faster and tougher, and escape death by returning to your spawn point, where they lose their non-permanent potion effects, are extinguished if burning and are invulnerable for 5 s. Bonds are made and broken only with the Book of Bonds.
subclass.rpgclasses.beast_master.name: Beast Master
subclass.rpgclasses.blessed_guardian.des: Healing protector. You receive more healing and your Bulwark heals the group with the damage you mitigate.
subclass.rpgclasses.breeze_master.desc: The fastest and the highest jumper, with an aerial dash.
subclass.rpgclasses.breeze_master.name: Breeze Master
A mountain of health. Your Bulwark becomes an unstoppable charge that tramples enemies.
subclass.rpgclasses.elementalist.desc: Your spells build charges on enemies; when full they detonate according to the school: fire explodes, ice freezes, lightning jumps in arcs, blood steals life, ender teleports, evocation raises fangs, nature roots and poisons, eldritch leaves the Mark of the Void (stores the damage it takes and then implodes), and water (with T.O Magic 'n Extras) launches a wave that pushes and soaks.
subclass.rpgclasses.elementalist.name: Elementalist
subclass.rpgclasses.heavy_palm.desc: Hits that knock back and reach farther. While crouching you charge the palm (more damage and knockback; at full charge it breaks guard). If the launched enemy crashes into a block or another enemy, it takes extra damage and is stunned and disabled.
subclass.rpgclasses.heavy_palm.name: Heavy Palm
subclass.rpgclasses.indestructible.desc: More health and the Gamble with Death: on a fatal hit a coin is flipped; on the ankh you survive (75% the first time, then 50%).
subclass.rpgclasses.indestructible.name: Indestructible
subclass.rpgclasses.plague_corruptor.des: Immune to hunger, poison and wither. Your hits spread the Plague, which damages over time even the undead.
subclass.rpgclasses.shadow_illusionist.d: Even harder to detect, and when you turn invisible you leave a decoy that distracts enemies.
subclass.rpgclasses.shadow_walker.desc: You move crouched as fast as walking and teleport short distances.
subclass.rpgclasses.shadow_walker.name: Shadow Walker
subclass.rpgclasses.sniper.desc: Very fast arrows and much more damage per shot, in exchange for drawing the bow slower.
subclass.rpgclasses.sniper.name: Sniper
subclass.rpgclasses.suicidal_berserker.d: More damage, and when you take a fatal hit you become immortal for a few seconds: if you kill your attacker, you live.
subclass.rpgclasses.triworld_guardian.de: Each stance protects you from one type of damage and adds its own effect: fire, water or stone.
subclass.rpgclasses.unyielding_bastion.d: Immovable. Immune to knockback, you resist bursts of hits and your Bulwark cleanses you of negative effects.
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.desc: You see in the dark underground and are immune to Darkness. Stone Sense (racial key 1, Rank 1) highlights nearby ores and lava.
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.deep.name: of the Depths
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.desc: Your own TNT does not hurt you and explodes with a 25% larger radius. From Rank 1, breaking an ore also breaks the connected ones (not while crouching). At Rank 3, crouching, you mine stone in a 3×3 tunnel (uses more hunger).
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.demolisher.name: Demolisher
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.desc: Things you craft or repair last longer (+20%, +40% at Rank 2). From Rank 1 the anvil costs you half the levels. At Rank 3 things you craft come out with Unbreaking +1 (maximum III).
subrace.rpgclasses.dwarf.smith.name: Smith
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.desc: The enchanting table counts as if its level were higher and enchanting (table or anvil) costs you less experience. At Rank 3, fuse two identical maximum-level enchantments at the anvil to exceed that maximum by 1.
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.arcane.name: Arcane
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.dark.desc: You see in any darkness. Smoke Cloud (racial key 1, Rank 1): you and your allies inside are invisible and mobs outside lose sight of you. It is not revealed by proximity.
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.dark.name: Dark
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.desc: Your crops give more yield; with ranks, plant food fills you more and you can grow crops with an empty hand.
subrace.rpgclasses.elf.sylvan.name: Sylvan
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.desc: Light Fingers: when hitting in melee you can steal an item from a mob's loot (without killing it) or from a player's inventory (never from the hotbar or the kit).
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.thief.name: Thief
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.desc: Snare (racial key 1): you place a trap that never expires, only you can see it and the first enemy to step on it takes damage and is immobilized.
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.trapper.name: Trapper
subrace.rpgclasses.goblin.wolf_rider.des: Right-click your wolf with an empty hand to ride it (crouching: make it sit, as usual). With ranks: your wolves have more health, the ridden wolf bites whatever you hit and regenerates while you ride it.
subrace.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.desc: You lose less XP when resetting your class or subclass: the loss is reduced by your Rank's percentage.
subrace.rpgclasses.human.autodidact.name: Autodidact
subrace.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.desc: Choose a second wall, which receives half the reduction.
subrace.rpgclasses.human.polyvalent.name: Polyvalent
subrace.rpgclasses.human.specialist.desc: The reduction of your chosen wall is 50% greater (up to −75% at Rank 3).
subrace.rpgclasses.human.specialist.name: Specialist
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.native.desc: Piglins, brutes and hoglins are neutral toward you unless you attack them. With ranks: immune to Wither, better bartering with piglins and Infernal Compass (racial key 1, Rank 3).
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.native.name: Native
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.pyromaniac.d: Your racial Fire Shot pierces enemies. With ranks, your racial Magma Bomb leaves a pool of flames and, at Rank 3, lava that slows. Requires Iron's Spells.
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.desc: You walk on lava. With ranks, nearby furnaces run faster, ores you mine come out smelted and you instantly smelt what you hold in hand (racial key 1, Rank 3).
subrace.rpgclasses.infernal.smelter.name: Smelter
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.desc: You eat raw meat and fish without negative effects and they fill you as if cooked. With ranks, killing feeds you and grants combat effects.
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.devourer.name: Devourer
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.desc: Thick Skin: each hit you take deals less damage by a fixed amount, with no minimum.
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.desc: Warlord's Voice (racial key 1): removes control effects from you and nearby allies.
subrace.rpgclasses.orc.warlord.name: Warlord
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.desc: Drowned and guardians are neutral toward you unless you attack them. With ranks: underwater immunities, camouflage and a guardian escort.
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.abyssal.name: Abyssal
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.desc: Fish bite sooner and you have racial Luck of the Sea when fishing; with ranks, extra catches, more treasure and more experience.
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.fisher.name: Fisher
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.desc: Tame Water (racial key 1): a temporary water source. Wave (racial key 2, Rank 1): pushes enemies; 2 charges at Rank 3. Water Wall (crouch + racial key 1, Rank 2).
subrace.rpgclasses.triton.shaper.name: Shaper
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.desc: Skeletons are neutral toward you unless you attack them and you take less projectile damage. At Rank 3 your regeneration is interrupted for less time.
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.skeleton.name: Skeleton
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.specter.desc: You take no fall damage and fall slowly (crouching prevents it). Ethereal Form (racial key 1, Rank 1): a few seconds unable to take damage or attack; it does not protect from the sun.
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.specter.name: Specter
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.desc: Thirst: killing heals you and, with ranks, you steal life from the damage you deal (with a per-second cap).
subrace.rpgclasses.undead.vampire.name: Vampire
ui.rpgclasses.ally.empty: There are no other players online.
ui.rpgclasses.ally.help: Your support only reaches your allies and your attacks don't affect them. Everyone else counts as an enemy.
ui.rpgclasses.ally.title: Allies
ui.rpgclasses.armor_rule: Wearing any piece of armor disables your "no armor" passives, except your class gear (Barbarian harnesses or Monk robes).
ui.rpgclasses.bond.no_nearby: You have no unbonded pets within %s blocks.
ui.rpgclasses.bond.none: You have no bonded pets yet.
ui.rpgclasses.bond.title: Book of Bonds
ui.rpgclasses.bond.unloaded: Not loaded: get closer to see or release it
ui.rpgclasses.branch_locked: Locked: you already use 3 branches. It unlocks when you reset your class.
ui.rpgclasses.branches_header: Branches (10 points each; each point raises all its passives). You can use 3 of the 5: when you put points into three, the other two are locked until you reset your class.
ui.rpgclasses.confirm_perk_text: It is free, but you won't be able to change it until you reset your class.
ui.rpgclasses.confirm_subclass_text: You can only have one subclass at a time. You can reset it, but each reset loses part of the XP spent.
ui.rpgclasses.confirm_text: You can only have one class. You can reset it later, but each reset loses part of the XP spent.
ui.rpgclasses.data.crit: Critical: %s chance, x%s damage plus the branch bonuses
ui.rpgclasses.data.xp_line: Level n: %s XP. Total: %s up to level 30 and %s for the 10 subclass levels.
ui.rpgclasses.must_choose: You must choose a class to start playing.
ui.rpgclasses.perks_line: Perk when full (you pick one, free, until you reset the class):
ui.rpgclasses.race.by_rank: Subrace traits. R0–R3 = value at each Rank (Ranks 1–3 are earned through rites).
ui.rpgclasses.race.confirm_text: Race and subrace are PERMANENT. They cannot be changed or reset, not even when resetting your class.
ui.rpgclasses.race.permanent: Race and subrace are permanent: they cannot be changed.
ui.rpgclasses.race.unavailable: Not available yet: its traits are in development.
ui.rpgclasses.race.wall_text: Adaptable reduces the penalty of the wall you choose. It is chosen when you choose a class and only changes when you reset it.
ui.rpgclasses.race.wall_text_second: Polyvalent: choose a second wall, which receives half the reduction.
ui.rpgclasses.respec_text: You will lose %s of the XP spent on what you reset; the rest is refunded. It cannot be done in combat.
ui.rpgclasses.subclass_locked: The subclass unlocks at %s base class points (you have %s).
ui.rpgclasses.subclass_note: The subclass unlocks at 15 base class points. It has 10 levels.
ui.rpgclasses.traits_header: Base class trait (full from the moment you choose the class)
ui.rpgclasses.upgrades: Upgrades %s: stays dormant until you have it.
ui.rpgclasses.walls_note: The wall grows with your base class points and reaches its maximum at 30. With %s points you would have %s.
